PURBASHA GRAMIN BANK
(A fictional bank) · Gaya Branch

Date: 02.10.2026

To,
Rina Das
100, Station Road, Gaya, Bihar - 823001

Sub: Reminder for overdue instalments in Loan Account No. 621883141906

Dear Customer,

This is to inform you that 2 EMI(s) of Rs. 6,120.00 each in your above loan account are overdue since 02.08.2026. The total overdue amount is Rs. 12,240.00, and penal interest of Rs. 490.00 has been levied as per the sanction terms.

You are requested to pay Rs. 12,730.00 on or before 09.10.2026 to regularise the account.

Please note that if the dues are not cleared, the account will be classified as a Non-Performing Asset (NPA) on 31.10.2026, which will affect your credit score, and the Bank may initiate recovery proceedings as per law.

If you have already paid, please ignore this letter.

Yours faithfully,
Branch Manager
